title: GuardrailEvalReport
description: Machine-checkable closure of the declared-unenforced gap for one policy version: every declared policy clause must map to an enforcement test, and installation of the policy requires BOTH a passing eval and a human blessing. Invariants: coverage arithmetic must be internally consistent and promotionEligible may be true only when every clause has a passing enforcement test (family validator); installApproved=true requires a blessing block (enforced by if/then) — an eval loop that feeds back into policy without a human gate is a self-modifying policy pipeline, which this contract forbids. The policy is identified by digest: installing by tag is the moving-tag trap.

specVersion.description: Epistemic-kernel contract version, pinned. Changing this const is a contract change.

policyDigest.description: Content digest of the exact policy version evaluated. Reports never apply to a moving reference.

clauseId.description: Stable identifier of the declared policy clause.

enforcementTestRef.description: URN or stable reference of the test that exercises this clause with a violating input. A clause without one is declared-unenforced by definition.

result.description: pass: the violating input was rejected; fail: it was admitted; untested: no enforcement test exists yet.

items.description: One declared clause and its enforcement evidence.

clauses.description: Per-clause enforcement results. Required (empty allowed) so a policy with no declared clauses states that explicitly.

declaredClauses.description: Number of clauses the policy declares.

enforcedClauses.description: Number of clauses with a passing enforcement test. Invariant (validator-enforced): never exceeds declaredClauses and must match the clauses array.

negativeVectors.description: Count of adversarial/red-team vectors run against this policy version. The red-team lane is a permanent input, not a phase.

coverage.description: Aggregate enforcement coverage for this policy version.

promotionEligible.description: Machine-side verdict: true only when enforcedClauses equals declaredClauses and every clause result is pass (validator-enforced). Eligibility is necessary but never sufficient for installation.

installApproved.description: Whether installation of this policy version was approved. Invariant (enforced by if/then): true requires a blessing block — the human gate on the eval→policy feedback edge.

blessing.description: Human approval record for installing this policy version.
